class="RichText_h3__yCDqQ h3"\>In the advent of digital ownership lesson, we explained how public blockchains like Ethereum made it possible to assign ownership to digital files, and prevent them from being spent twice.\</h2\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>While the internet was able to make digital files infinitely copyable, this isn�t ideal if you are an artist who only wanted to make 10 original edition copies, or a musician who wanted to issue a limited edition album.\</p\>\<p\>Ethereum made digital scarcity possible because data added to a public blockchain means that everyone can see who owns what, and verify their ownership as they change hands.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide_background__T1URj sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: var(--mm-green-200); --text-color: var(--mm-green-800); --border-color: var(--mm-green-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%;"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(min-width: 769px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(max-width: 768px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70" media="(max-width: 768x)"\>\<img alt="Digital Asset 6" desktopsize="400" data-cursor="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" src="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70" style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 100%; inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_wrapper__2IwmY"\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module sideBySide_subhead__3dhLE subhead_nested__uH3u0"\>\<div class="subhead_full__ZS1FS"\>\<p role="heading" aria-level="3"\>While the digital is still infinitely copyable, the ownership of the digital file is not. How is that possible?\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module sideBySide_body__5dyRB body_right__evLEL body_nested__jaaP0"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>If you can bear the economic jargon for a moment, the concept that led us here is important to explain briefly. Ethereum is fungible � you can trade 1 ETH for another ETH, and you have exactly the same thing.\</p\>\<p\>Non-fungible means that it is a one-of-a-kind. In web3, non-fungible tokens, or NFTs are provably scarce digital items, whether that be digital trading cards, tickets to an event, in-game items, digital music, or art.\</p\>\<p\>NFTs don�t make it impossible to copy the digital files (yes, go ahead and �right click, save as� all you want), but it does make it possible to link digital ownership to the digital file to prove that it is the �real� one, all of which is stored and visible on Ethereum or another public blockchain.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<svg class="sideBySide_exclude__3ZS32" width="75" height="75" viewBox="0 0 75 75" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation"\>\<path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M-3.27826e-06 0C5.30433 0 10.3914 2.10713 14.1422 5.85786L41.2843 33L68.4264 60.1421C72.1772 63.8929 74.2843 68.9799 74.2843 74.2843V0H-3.27826e-06Z" fill="white"\>\</path\>\</svg\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextImage__aoVGV"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h5__aagCs h5"\>So think of NFTs like a certificate of authenticity: while the original work can be copied infinitely, the certificate lets you know which is the original.\</h3\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>NFTs brought Ethereum to the mainstream in 2021, not least for the celebrities and artists that drew headlines for record breaking sales, Beeple who sold his �5,000 days� work for $69.3 million in 2021, positioned him between Koons and Hockney as �the top three most valuable living artists� according to Christie�s, which held the auction. Millions of people use MetaMask to buy and sell NFTs on marketplaces, or directly from artists.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="image_image__cy9hD image_nextBody__jnA1a image-module"\>\<div class="image_wrapper__sToOh"\>\<div class="image_bg__Hgv1u" style="background: var(--mm-sky-blue-200);"\>\</div\>\<div\>\<div style="position: relative; width: 100%; padding-top: 56.298343%;"\>\<picture style="position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%;"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(min-width: 769px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(max-width: 768px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70" media="(max-width: 768x)"\>\<img alt="Twitch 1" desktopsize="1600" data-cursor="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" src="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70" style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 100%; inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>But NFTs mean more than speculative investments. They represent new ways for creators to monetize their art and even connect with their fans. A lot of ink has been spilled explaining how social media and music streaming platforms changed the relationship between creators and fans by introducing a new intermediary: the platform.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module"\>\<div class="subhead_center__pzfi3"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h4__TMymA h4"\>For example, if you released music on Spotify in 2021 and received an average number of plays, you would have made only about $636. YouTube on the other hand paid out about $2.47 per channel, and Meta, a paltry $0.10 per creator.\</h3\>\<p\>\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextSideBySide__mQ_f1"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>On the other hand, web3 paid out about $174,000 per creator in 2021. While each of the 22,400 web3 artist�s didn�t rake in these types of figures, it does show that NFTs became a significant industry for the creator class, with over $9 billion in primary sales and royalties on secondary sales. For many creators operating in these new digital spaces, NFTs represented the first bonafide way to support their craft full-time.\</p\>\<p\>The increasingly vague �creator economy� is a term used to describe internet spaces meant to help creators monetize in new ways. OnlyFans, Twitch, and other platforms promise platform users freedom to earn directly from their fans instead of relying on an ad-driven, attention-based monetization model like a social network. However, unlike web3 networks, creators can be booted from the network capriciously, and don�t own the content that they share.\</p\>\<p\>With NFTs as a part of the patron-artist relationship, artists also have a direct line with their earliest supporters � a collection of Ethereum addresses or ENS names that can be used for mailing lists, entry passes, and payment systems for artists to engage their fans no matter the platform they are using.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide-module-transparent sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: transparent; --text-color: var(--mm-black); --border-color: var(--mm-light-gray-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div class="sideBySide_image__f_Fjf"\>\<svg class="RichText_h3__yCDqQ h3"\>In the advent of digital ownership lesson, we explained how public blockchains like Ethereum made it possible to assign ownership to digital files, and prevent them from being spent twice.\</h2\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>While the internet was able to make digital files infinitely copyable, this isn�t ideal if you are an artist who only wanted to make 10 original edition copies, or a musician who wanted to issue a limited edition album.\</p\>\<p\>Ethereum made digital scarcity possible because data added to a public blockchain means that everyone can see who owns what, and verify their ownership as they change hands.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide_background__T1URj sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: var(--mm-green-200); --text-color: var(--mm-green-800); --border-color: var(--mm-green-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%;"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(min-width: src="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70" style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 100%; inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_wrapper__2IwmY"\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module sideBySide_subhead__3dhLE subhead_nested__uH3u0"\>\<div class="subhead_full__ZS1FS"\>\<p role="heading" aria-level="3"\>While the digital is still infinitely copyable, the ownership of the digital file is not. How is that possible?\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module sideBySide_body__5dyRB body_right__evLEL body_nested__jaaP0"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>If you can bear the economic jargon for a moment, the concept that led us here is important to explain briefly. Ethereum is fungible � you can trade 1 ETH for another ETH, and you have exactly the same thing.\</p\>\<p\>Non-fungible means that it is a one-of-a-kind. In web3, non-fungible tokens, or NFTs are provably scarce digital items, whether that be digital trading cards, tickets to an event, in-game items, digital music, or art.\</p\>\<p\>NFTs don�t make it impossible to copy the digital files (yes, go ahead and �right click, save as� all you want), but it does make it possible to link digital ownership to the digital file to prove that it is the �real� one, all of which is stored and visible on Ethereum or another public blockchain.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<svg class="sideBySide_exclude__3ZS32" width="75" height="75" viewBox="0 0 75 75" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation"\>\<path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M-3.27826e-06 0C5.30433 0 10.3914 2.10713 14.1422 5.85786L41.2843 33L68.4264 60.1421C72.1772 63.8929 74.2843 68.9799 74.2843 74.2843V0H-3.27826e-06Z" fill="white"\>\</path\>\</svg\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextImage__aoVGV"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h5__aagCs h5"\>So think of NFTs like a certificate of authenticity: while the original work can be copied infinitely, the certificate lets you know which is the original.\</h3\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>NFTs brought Ethereum to the mainstream in 2021, not least for the celebrities and artists that drew headlines for record breaking sales, Beeple who sold his �5,000 days� work for $69.3 million in 2021, positioned him between Koons and Hockney as �the top three most valuable living artists� according to Christie�s, which held the auction. Millions of people use MetaMask to buy and sell NFTs on marketplaces, or directly from artists.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="image_image__cy9hD image_nextBody__jnA1a image-module"\>\<div class="image_wrapper__sToOh"\>\<div class="image_bg__Hgv1u" style="background: var(--mm-sky-blue-200);"\>\</div\>\<div\>\<div style="position: relative; width: 100%; padding-top: 56.298343%;"\>\<picture style="position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%;"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(min-width: 769px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(max-width: 768px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70" media="(max-width: 768x)"\>\<img alt="Twitch 1" desktopsize="1600" data-cursor="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" src="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70" style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 100%; inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>But NFTs mean more than speculative investments. They represent new ways for creators to monetize their art and even connect with their fans. A lot of ink has been spilled explaining how social media and music streaming platforms changed the relationship between creators and fans by introducing a new intermediary: the platform.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module"\>\<div class="subhead_center__pzfi3"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h4__TMymA h4"\>For example, if you released music on Spotify in 2021 and received an average number of plays, you would have made only about $636. YouTube on the other hand paid out about $2.47 per channel, and Meta, a paltry $0.10 per creator.\</h3\>\<p\>\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextSideBySide__mQ_f1"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>On the other hand, web3 paid out about $174,000 per creator in 2021. While each of the 22,400 web3 artist�s didn�t rake in these types of figures, it does show that NFTs became a significant industry for the creator class, with over $9 billion in primary sales and royalties on secondary sales. For many creators operating in these new digital spaces, NFTs represented the first bonafide way to support their craft full-time.\</p\>\<p\>The increasingly vague �creator economy� is a term used to describe internet spaces meant to help creators monetize in new ways. OnlyFans, Twitch, and other platforms promise platform users freedom to earn directly from their fans instead of relying on an ad-driven, attention-based monetization model like a social network. However, unlike web3 networks, creators can be booted from the network capriciously, and don�t own the content that they share.\</p\>\<p\>With NFTs as a part of the patron-artist relationship, artists also have a direct line with their earliest supporters � a collection of Ethereum addresses or ENS names that can be used for mailing lists, entry passes, and payment systems for artists to engage their fans no matter the platform they are using.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide-module-transparent sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: transparent; --text-color: var(--mm-black); --border-color: var(--mm-light-gray-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div class="sideBySide_image__f_Fjf"\>\<svg NFTs can be bought on one service, sold on a secondary market, or used for other games and applications.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module sideBySide_body__5dyRB body_right__evLEL body_nested__jaaP0"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>In other words, by inheriting the properties of Ethereum, NFTs are portable and interoperable representations of, well, class="RichText_h3__yCDqQ h3"\>In the advent of digital ownership lesson, we explained how public blockchains like Ethereum made it possible to assign ownership to digital files, and prevent them from being spent twice.\</h2\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>While the internet was able to make digital files infinitely copyable, this isn�t ideal if you are an artist who only wanted to make 10 original edition copies, or a musician who wanted to issue a limited edition album.\</p\>\<p\>Ethereum made digital scarcity possible because data added to a public blockchain means that everyone can see who owns what, and verify their ownership as they change hands.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide_background__T1URj sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: var(--mm-green-200); --text-color: var(--mm-green-800); --border-color: var(--mm-green-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div 0Z" fill="transparent"\>\</path\>\</svg\>\<div class="sideBySide_image_wrap__oWfZ3" style="position: relative; width: 100%; padding-top: 84.408284%;"\>\<picture style="position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%;"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(min-width: 769px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(max-width: 768px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70" media="(max-width: 768x)"\>\<img alt="Digital Asset 6" desktopsize="400" data-cursor="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" src="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70" style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 100%; inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_wrapper__2IwmY"\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module sideBySide_subhead__3dhLE subhead_nested__uH3u0"\>\<div class="subhead_full__ZS1FS"\>\<p role="heading" aria-level="3"\>While the digital is still infinitely copyable, the ownership of the digital file is not. How is that possible?\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module sideBySide_body__5dyRB body_right__evLEL body_nested__jaaP0"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>If you can bear the economic jargon for a moment, the concept that led us here is important to explain briefly. Ethereum is fungible � you can trade 1 ETH for another ETH, and you have exactly the same thing.\</p\>\<p\>Non-fungible means that it is a one-of-a-kind. In web3, non-fungible tokens, or NFTs are provably scarce digital items, whether that be digital trading cards, tickets to an event, in-game items, digital music, or art.\</p\>\<p\>NFTs don�t make it impossible to copy the digital files (yes, go ahead and �right click, save as� all you want), but it does make it possible to link digital ownership to the digital file to prove that it is the �real� one, all of which is stored and visible on Ethereum or another public blockchain.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<svg class="sideBySide_exclude__3ZS32" width="75" height="75" viewBox="0 0 75 75" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation"\>\<path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M-3.27826e-06 0C5.30433 0 10.3914 2.10713 14.1422 5.85786L41.2843 33L68.4264 60.1421C72.1772 63.8929 74.2843 68.9799 74.2843 74.2843V0H-3.27826e-06Z" fill="white"\>\</path\>\</svg\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextImage__aoVGV"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h5__aagCs h5"\>So think of NFTs like a certificate of authenticity: while the original work can be copied infinitely, the certificate lets you know which is the original.\</h3\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>NFTs brought Ethereum to the mainstream in 2021, not least for the celebrities and artists that drew headlines for record breaking sales, Beeple who sold his �5,000 days� work for $69.3 million in 2021, positioned him between Koons and Hockney as �the top three most valuable living artists� according to Christie�s, which held the auction. Millions of people use MetaMask to buy and sell NFTs on marketplaces, or directly from artists.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="image_image__cy9hD image_nextBody__jnA1a image-module"\>\<div class="image_wrapper__sToOh"\>\<div class="image_bg__Hgv1u" style="background: var(--mm-sky-blue-200);"\>\</div\>\<div\>\<div style="position: relative; width: 100%; padding-top: 56.298343%;"\>\<picture style="position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%;"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(min-width: 769px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(max-width: 768px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70" media="(max-width: 768x)"\>\<img alt="Twitch 1" desktopsize="1600" data-cursor="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" src="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70" style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 100%; inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>But NFTs mean more than speculative investments. They represent new ways for creators to monetize their art and even connect with their fans. A lot of ink has been spilled explaining how social media and music streaming platforms changed the relationship between creators and fans by introducing a new intermediary: the platform.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module"\>\<div class="subhead_center__pzfi3"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h4__TMymA h4"\>For example, if you released music on Spotify in 2021 and received an average number of plays, you would have made only about $636. YouTube on the other hand paid out about $2.47 per channel, and Meta, a paltry $0.10 per creator.\</h3\>\<p\>\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextSideBySide__mQ_f1"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>On the other hand, web3 paid out about $174,000 per creator in 2021. While each of the 22,400 web3 artist�s didn�t rake in these types of figures, it does show that NFTs became a significant industry for the creator class, with over $9 billion in primary sales and royalties on secondary sales. For many creators operating in these new digital spaces, NFTs represented the first bonafide way to support their craft full-time.\</p\>\<p\>The increasingly vague �creator economy� is a term used to describe internet spaces meant to help creators monetize in new ways. OnlyFans, Twitch, and other platforms promise platform users freedom to earn directly from their fans instead of relying on an ad-driven, attention-based monetization model like a social network. However, unlike web3 networks, creators can be booted from the network capriciously, and don�t own the content that they share.\</p\>\<p\>With NFTs as a part of the patron-artist relationship, artists also have a direct line with their earliest supporters � a collection of Ethereum addresses or ENS names that can be used for mailing lists, entry passes, and payment systems for artists to engage their fans no matter the platform they are using.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide-module-transparent sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: transparent; --text-color: var(--mm-black); --border-color: var(--mm-light-gray-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div class="sideBySide_image__f_Fjf"\>\<svg class="RichText_h3__yCDqQ h3"\>In the advent of digital ownership lesson, we explained how public blockchains like Ethereum made it possible to assign ownership to digital files, and prevent them from being spent twice.\</h2\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>While the internet was able to make digital files infinitely copyable, this isn�t ideal if you are an artist who only wanted to make 10 original edition copies, or a musician who wanted to issue a limited edition album.\</p\>\<p\>Ethereum made digital scarcity possible because data added to a public blockchain means that everyone can see who owns what, and verify their ownership as they change hands.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide_background__T1URj sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: var(--mm-green-200); --text-color: var(--mm-green-800); --border-color: var(--mm-green-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_wrapper__2IwmY"\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module sideBySide_subhead__3dhLE subhead_nested__uH3u0"\>\<div class="subhead_full__ZS1FS"\>\<p role="heading" aria-level="3"\>While the digital is still infinitely copyable, the ownership of the digital file is not. How is that possible?\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module sideBySide_body__5dyRB body_right__evLEL body_nested__jaaP0"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>If you can bear the economic jargon for a moment, the concept that led us here is important to explain briefly. Ethereum is fungible � you can trade 1 ETH for another ETH, and you have exactly the same thing.\</p\>\<p\>Non-fungible means that it is a one-of-a-kind. In web3, non-fungible tokens, or NFTs are provably scarce digital items, whether that be digital trading cards, tickets to an event, in-game items, digital music, or art.\</p\>\<p\>NFTs don�t make it impossible to copy the digital files (yes, go ahead and �right click, save as� all you want), but it does make it possible to link digital ownership to the digital file to prove that it is the �real� one, all of which is stored and visible on Ethereum or another public blockchain.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<svg class="sideBySide_exclude__3ZS32" width="75" height="75" viewBox="0 0 75 75" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation"\>\<path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M-3.27826e-06 0C5.30433 0 10.3914 2.10713 14.1422 5.85786L41.2843 33L68.4264 60.1421C72.1772 63.8929 74.2843 68.9799 74.2843 74.2843V0H-3.27826e-06Z" fill="white"\>\</path\>\</svg\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextImage__aoVGV"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h5__aagCs h5"\>So think of NFTs like a certificate of authenticity: while the original work can be copied infinitely, the certificate lets you know which is the original.\</h3\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>NFTs brought Ethereum to the mainstream in 2021, not least for the celebrities and artists that drew headlines for record breaking sales, Beeple who sold his �5,000 days� work for $69.3 million in 2021, positioned him between Koons and Hockney as �the top three most valuable living artists� according to Christie�s, which held the auction. Millions of people use MetaMask to buy and sell NFTs on marketplaces, or directly from artists.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="image_image__cy9hD image_nextBody__jnA1a image-module"\>\<div class="image_wrapper__sToOh"\>\<div class="image_bg__Hgv1u" style="background: var(--mm-sky-blue-200);"\>\</div\>\<div\>\<div style="position: relative; width: 100%; padding-top: 56.298343%;"\>\<picture style="position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%;"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(min-width: 769px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(max-width: 768px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70" media="(max-width: 768x)"\>\<img alt="Twitch 1" desktopsize="1600" data-cursor="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" src="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70" style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 100%; inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>But NFTs mean more than speculative investments. They represent new ways for creators to monetize their art and even connect with their fans. A lot of ink has been spilled explaining how social media and music streaming platforms changed the relationship between creators and fans by introducing a new intermediary: the platform.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module"\>\<div class="subhead_center__pzfi3"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h4__TMymA h4"\>For example, if you released music on Spotify in 2021 and received an average number of plays, you would have made only about $636. YouTube on the other hand paid out about $2.47 per channel, and Meta, a paltry $0.10 per creator.\</h3\>\<p\>\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextSideBySide__mQ_f1"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>On the other hand, web3 paid out about $174,000 per creator in 2021. While each of the 22,400 web3 artist�s didn�t rake in these types of figures, it does show that NFTs became a significant industry for the creator class, with over $9 billion in primary sales and royalties on secondary sales. For many creators operating in these new digital spaces, NFTs represented the first bonafide way to support their craft full-time.\</p\>\<p\>The increasingly vague �creator economy� is a term used to describe internet spaces meant to help creators monetize in new ways. OnlyFans, Twitch, and other platforms promise platform users freedom to earn directly from their fans instead of relying on an ad-driven, attention-based monetization model like a social network. However, unlike web3 networks, creators can be booted from the network capriciously, and don�t own the content that they share.\</p\>\<p\>With NFTs as a part of the patron-artist relationship, artists also have a direct line with their earliest supporters � a collection of Ethereum addresses or ENS names that can be used for mailing lists, entry passes, and payment systems for artists to engage their fans no matter the platform they are using.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide-module-transparent sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: transparent; --text-color: var(--mm-black); --border-color: var(--mm-light-gray-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div class="sideBySide_image__f_Fjf"\>\<svg class="RichText_h3__yCDqQ h3"\>In the advent of digital ownership lesson, we explained how public blockchains like Ethereum made it possible to assign ownership to digital files, and prevent them from being spent twice.\</h2\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>While the internet was able to make digital files infinitely copyable, this isn�t ideal if you are an artist who only wanted to make 10 original edition copies, or a musician who wanted to issue a limited edition album.\</p\>\<p\>Ethereum made digital scarcity possible because data added to a public blockchain means that everyone can see who owns what, and verify their ownership as they change hands.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide_background__T1URj sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: var(--mm-green-200); --text-color: var(--mm-green-800); --border-color: var(--mm-green-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div 0Z" fill="transparent"\>\</path\>\</svg\>\<div class="sideBySide_image_wrap__oWfZ3" style="position: relative; width: 100%; padding-top: 84.408284%;"\>\<picture style="position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%;"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(min-width: 769px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(max-width: 768px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70" media="(max-width: 768x)"\>\<img alt="Digital Asset 6" desktopsize="400" data-cursor="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" src="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/1b9fEbbqbOcSborYmSqFgT/8fe1e4c41a4ae27076f5aa40ab08fe33/Music_1.png?w=400&amp;h=400&amp;q=70" style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 100%; inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_wrapper__2IwmY"\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module sideBySide_subhead__3dhLE subhead_nested__uH3u0"\>\<div class="subhead_full__ZS1FS"\>\<p role="heading" aria-level="3"\>While the digital is still infinitely copyable, the ownership of the digital file is not. How is that possible?\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module sideBySide_body__5dyRB body_right__evLEL body_nested__jaaP0"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>If you can bear the economic jargon for a moment, the concept that led us here is important to explain briefly. Ethereum is fungible � you can trade 1 ETH for another ETH, and you have exactly the same thing.\</p\>\<p\>Non-fungible means that it is a one-of-a-kind. In web3, non-fungible tokens, or NFTs are provably scarce digital items, whether that be digital trading cards, tickets to an event, in-game items, digital music, or art.\</p\>\<p\>NFTs don�t make it impossible to copy the digital files (yes, go ahead and �right click, save as� all you want), but it does make it possible to link digital ownership to the digital file to prove that it is the �real� one, all of which is stored and visible on Ethereum or another public blockchain.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<svg class="sideBySide_exclude__3ZS32" width="75" height="75" viewBox="0 0 75 75" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation"\>\<path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M-3.27826e-06 0C5.30433 0 10.3914 2.10713 14.1422 5.85786L41.2843 33L68.4264 60.1421C72.1772 63.8929 74.2843 68.9799 74.2843 74.2843V0H-3.27826e-06Z" fill="white"\>\</path\>\</svg\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextImage__aoVGV"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h5__aagCs h5"\>So think of NFTs like a certificate of authenticity: while the original work can be copied infinitely, the certificate lets you know which is the original.\</h3\>\<hr class="RichText_hr__iVqF0"\>\<p\>NFTs brought Ethereum to the mainstream in 2021, not least for the celebrities and artists that drew headlines for record breaking sales, Beeple who sold his �5,000 days� work for $69.3 million in 2021, positioned him between Koons and Hockney as �the top three most valuable living artists� according to Christie�s, which held the auction. Millions of people use MetaMask to buy and sell NFTs on marketplaces, or directly from artists.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="image_image__cy9hD image_nextBody__jnA1a image-module"\>\<div class="image_wrapper__sToOh"\>\<div class="image_bg__Hgv1u" style="background: var(--mm-sky-blue-200);"\>\</div\>\<div\>\<div style="position: relative; width: 100%; padding-top: 56.298343%;"\>\<picture style="position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%;"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(min-width: 769px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70&amp;fm=webp" type="image/webp" media="(max-width: 768px)"\>\<source srcset="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=600&amp;h=600&amp;q=70" media="(max-width: 768x)"\>\<img alt="Twitch 1" desktopsize="1600" data-cursor="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" src="https://images.ctfassets.net/u00r7c0tdztm/5WvrWu98SfRyN77seeJ6I6/596a50ecd6ddfccbd56fc00e5d9809c7/Twitch_1.png?w=1600&amp;h=1600&amp;q=70" style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 100%; inset: 0px; object-fit: contain; color: transparent; transition: opacity 0.4s; opacity: 1;"\>\</picture\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>But NFTs mean more than speculative investments. They represent new ways for creators to monetize their art and even connect with their fans. A lot of ink has been spilled explaining how social media and music streaming platforms changed the relationship between creators and fans by introducing a new intermediary: the platform.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="subhead_subhead__CNOQj subhead-module"\>\<div class="subhead_center__pzfi3"\>\<h3 class="RichText_h4__TMymA h4"\>For example, if you released music on Spotify in 2021 and received an average number of plays, you would have made only about $636. YouTube on the other hand paid out about $2.47 per channel, and Meta, a paltry $0.10 per creator.\</h3\>\<p\>\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="body_body__PH99X body-module body_right__evLEL body_nextSideBySide__mQ_f1"\>\<div class="body_wrapper__dk90r"\>\<p\>On the other hand, web3 paid out about $174,000 per creator in 2021. While each of the 22,400 web3 artist�s didn�t rake in these types of figures, it does show that NFTs became a significant industry for the creator class, with over $9 billion in primary sales and royalties on secondary sales. For many creators operating in these new digital spaces, NFTs represented the first bonafide way to support their craft full-time.\</p\>\<p\>The increasingly vague �creator economy� is a term used to describe internet spaces meant to help creators monetize in new ways. OnlyFans, Twitch, and other platforms promise platform users freedom to earn directly from their fans instead of relying on an ad-driven, attention-based monetization model like a social network. However, unlike web3 networks, creators can be booted from the network capriciously, and don�t own the content that they share.\</p\>\<p\>With NFTs as a part of the patron-artist relationship, artists also have a direct line with their earliest supporters � a collection of Ethereum addresses or ENS names that can be used for mailing lists, entry passes, and payment systems for artists to engage their fans no matter the platform they are using.\</p\>\</div\>\</div\>\<div class="sideBySide_sideBySide__PqIRA sideBySide-module-transparent sideBySide-module" style="--background-color: transparent; --text-color: var(--mm-black); --border-color: var(--mm-light-gray-400);"\>\<div class="layout_Grid__fWe2D sideBySide_content__cwsua"\>\<div class="sideBySide_image__f_Fjf"\>\<svg
